fields.name: LoggingExtensions.ExpressionTreeCreatedEvents
fields.contract: The compiled-delegate reporting family, six public wrapper methods all logging at Debug under event id ExpressionTreeCreation (1): CreatedExpressionTreeForSetInParameters, CreatedExpressionTreeForSetOutParameters, CreatedExpressionTreeForReadOutParameters, CreatedExpressionTreeForReaderOrdinals, CreatedExpressionTreeForReaderRowData each take (this ILogger logger, Type model, Expression codeBlock); CreatedExpressionTreeForModel additionally takes a string procedureName. Each guards the expensive DebugViewWriter rendering with `if (logger.IsEnabled(LogLevel.Debug))`, matching its delegate's own level, so no rendering happens when Debug is disabled; when enabled it renders codeBlock into a human-readable expression-tree listing and logs it together with the model type (and, for the Model variant, the procedure name). Each method invokes its own delegate, whose EventId.Name equals the method name: CreatedExpressionTreeForReaderOrdinals reports under "CreatedExpressionTreeForReaderOrdinals" with an "...ordinals to data reader values..." message, distinct from CreatedExpressionTreeForReaderRowData's "...to data reader row values..." message.
